parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specify the response format, only supporting `application/json`.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Use `multipart/form-data` to upload image files, or use `application/json` to reference images via URL (extended mode; JSON mode does not support direct upload of file bytes).

n.description: Number of images to generate (1-10). `dall-e-3` is fixed at `1`. The `dall-e-2`, `gpt-image-1` / `gpt-image-1.5` / `gpt-image-2` series, as well as the `nano-banana` / `nano-banana-2-lite` / `nano-banana-2` / `nano-banana-pro` series all support `n>1`: they will return and charge for the corresponding number of edited results. Note that `response_format=b64_json` only supports `n=1`, for `n>1` please use the default URL return. If some images fail to generate, only the successful parts will be returned and charged.

size.description: Image size, in the format of `WIDTHxHEIGHT`, or `auto`. **`gpt-image-2`** accepts any `WIDTHxHEIGHT` value that conforms to this format, including 1K presets (`1024x1024`, `1536x1024`, `1024x1536`, `1792x1024`, `1024x1792`), 2K presets (`2048x2048`, `2048x1536`, `1536x2048`, `2048x1152`, `1152x2048`), 4K presets (`2880x2880`, `3264x2448`, `2448x3264`, `3840x2160`, `2160x3840`), and custom sizes; regardless of the size, each image is billed at a fixed price. Size limitations: custom sizes must be multiples of 16, with the long side ≤ 3840, and total pixel count ≤ 8,294,400. `dall-e-2` supports: `256x256`, `512x512`, `1024x1024`. Passing `auto` allows the model to choose automatically.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

image.description: Reference image URL. Accepts a single URL string or an array of URL strings (up to 16). The JSON schema **does not** accept uploaded file bytes—if you need to upload files directly, please use `multipart/form-data`.

model.description: Models used for image editing. Supports `dall-e-2`, `dall-e-3`, GPT Image series (`gpt-image-1`, `gpt-image-1.5`, `gpt-image-2`), and Google Nano Banana series (`nano-banana`, `nano-banana-2-lite`, `nano-banana-2`, `nano-banana-pro`). `gpt-image-2` offers two optional suffix variants: `gpt-image-2:official` (official channel, stable and compliant, supports higher resolution, billed at double the price per image) and `gpt-image-2:reverse` (equivalent to the default `gpt-image-2`, more cost-effective).

prompt.example: Turn this photo into a Studio Ghibli style painting.
prompt.description: Describe the text of the desired editing effect. `dall-e-2` up to 1000 characters, GPT Image series models up to 32000 characters.

quality.description: Image quality. The GPT Image series models support: `auto`, `high`, `medium`, `low`.

background.description: Only applicable to the GPT Image series models. Transparency handling methods: `transparent` (transparent), `opaque` (opaque), or `auto` (automatic).

callback_url.description: Optional callback URL. When provided, the interface immediately returns `task_id` and pushes the results to that URL via POST after the image editing is completed.

output_format.description: The return formats of the GPT Image series models are: `png`, `jpeg`, or `webp`.

input_fidelity.description: Matching strength of style and features of the input image (applicable to GPT Image series models).

n.description: Number of images to generate (1-10). `dall-e-3` is fixed at `1`. The `dall-e-2`, `gpt-image-1` / `gpt-image-1.5` / `gpt-image-2` series, as well as the `nano-banana` / `nano-banana-2-lite` / `nano-banana-2` / `nano-banana-pro` series all support `n>1`: they will return and charge for the corresponding number of edited results. Note that `response_format=b64_json` only supports `n=1`, and for `n>1`, please use the default URL return. If some images fail to generate, only the successful parts will be returned and charged.

mask.description: Optional mask image (PNG, no more than 4MB, size must match the first image). The transparent area indicates the editable region.

size.description: Image size, in the format of `WIDTHxHEIGHT`, or `auto`. **`gpt-image-2`** accepts any `WIDTHxHEIGHT` value that conforms to this format, including 1K presets (`1024x1024`, `1536x1024`, `1024x1536`, `1792x1024`, `1024x1792`), 2K presets (`2048x2048`, `2048x1536`, `1536x2048`, `2048x1152`, `1152x2048`), 4K presets (`2880x2880`, `3264x2448`, `2448x3264`, `3840x2160`, `2160x3840`), and custom sizes; regardless of the size, each image is billed at a fixed price. Size limitations: custom sizes must be multiples of 16, with the long side ≤ 3840, and total pixel count ≤ 8,294,400. `dall-e-2` supports: `256x256`, `512x512`, `1024x1024`.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

image.description: Images to be edited. GPT Image series model: up to 16 images (png/webp/jpg), each not exceeding 50MB. `dall-e-2`: a single square PNG, not exceeding 4MB.

model.description: Models used for image editing. Supports `dall-e-2`, `dall-e-3`, GPT Image series (`gpt-image-1`, `gpt-image-1.5`, `gpt-image-2`) as well as Google Nano Banana series (`nano-banana`, `nano-banana-2-lite`, `nano-banana-2`, `nano-banana-pro`). `gpt-image-2` offers two optional suffix variants: `gpt-image-2:official` (official channel, stable and compliant, supports higher resolution, billed at double the price per image) and `gpt-image-2:reverse` (equivalent to the default `gpt-image-2`, more cost-effective).

prompt.description: Describe the text of the desired editing effect. `dall-e-2` up to 1000 characters, GPT Image series models up to 32000 characters.

quality.description: Image quality. GPT Image series models: `auto` (default), `high`, `medium`, `low`. `dall-e-2`: only supports `standard`.

background.description: Only applicable to the GPT Image series models. Transparency handling methods: `transparent` (transparent), `opaque` (opaque), or `auto` (automatic, default value). For transparent effects, please use `png` or `webp` output formats.

callback_url.description: Optional callback URL. Once provided, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, and after the image editing is completed, the result will be pushed to this URL via POST. The callback payload contains `task_id`, `trace_id`, `success` (boolean), and the complete response data or error message.

output_format.description: The return formats of the GPT Image series models are: `png`, `jpeg`, or `webp`.

input_fidelity.description: The matching strength of the style and features of the input image. `gpt-image-1` supports it, while `gpt-image-1-mini` does not support it.

partial_images.description: The number of intermediate images in the streaming response (0-3). Set to `0` to return only the final image event.

response_format.description: The response format of `dall-e-2`: `url` or `b64_json`. The GPT Image series models always return in Base64 format.

output_compression.description: The compression level (0-100%) for the GPT Image series model when outputting in `webp` or `jpeg`.
